text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Fufu. I was just checking out 
the new boot releases.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's super cute! They have it in yellow 
and black... look! Oh, right! I'll zoom in 
so you can see—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No way, seriously!? 99 of them ordered 
already!? Wait, that was a misclick— 
Aaaaaahh...!?
